description:
At the university's opening assembly, Do-Hun unexpectedly encounters ‘ae-Hyeon, a special person from his middle school days with whom he shared a deep bond during a brief period. However, Jae-Hyeon not only fails to recognize Do-Hun but also carries rumors of sleeping around with multiple men. Hearing these rumors, Do-Hun impulsively joins Jae-Hyeon for drinks and ends up having a one-night stand with him. Using the one-night stand as leverage, Do-Hun blackmails Jae-Hyeon into agreeing to have sex only with him. He then demands various acts like using sex toys and cosplay, humiliating him and marking the beginning of their twisted relationship.

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)
